name: Warranty Tracking
description: Endpoint hardware warranty status across whatever RMM platforms (Datto RMM, NinjaOne, N-central, Kaseya VSA, ConnectWise Automate, Atera, SuperOps, Syncro, Action1, ImmyBot) and documentation tools (IT Glue, Hudu) are connected: the reliability spread between OEM-resolved and hand-entered warranty fields, serial/asset-tag cross-referencing when RMM data is missing or stale, and the expired / expiring-soon / covered / unknown bucketing.
